entry.summary: Applications rely on current Stripe data to fulfill orders, update customer accounts, and manage access to paid features. Until now, developers have had to build and maintain custom integrations to ke
entry.content: Applications rely on current Stripe data to fulfill orders, update customer accounts, and manage access to paid features.
